mutations.name: C1 the finite guard is dropped: a NaN limit reaches the widening search, whose two exits are both permanently false for it, so the read never returns and its caller is never told
mutations.expectRed: 1.1 a NaN limit REFUSES, naming what it received, rather than never returning

mutations.name: C2 the guard stops refusing and returns an empty page instead, the fallback shape: a caller who asked an unanswerable question is told the channel is empty
mutations.find: throw new Error(`history limit must be a whole number of messages this server can count exactly, received ${limit}`);
mutations.expectRed: 1.1 a NaN limit REFUSES, naming what it received, rather than never returning

mutations.name: C3 the refusal stops naming the value it received, so a caller who computed a bad limit is told a rule was broken but not which value broke it
mutations.find: throw new Error(`history limit must be a whole number of messages this server can count exactly, received ${limit}`);
mutations.replace: throw new Error("history limit must be a whole number of messages this server can count exactly");
mutations.expectRed: 1.1 a NaN limit REFUSES, naming what it received, rather than never returning

mutations.name: C4 the guard widens and swallows the working cases too: zero and negatives start throwing instead of returning an empty page, changing a contract this change was not supposed to touch
mutations.replace:
if (!Number.isSafeInteger(limit) || limit <= 0)
      throw new Error(`history limit must be a whole number of messages this server can count exactly, received ${limit}`);
mutations.expectRed: 2.1 zero still means an EMPTY page, not a throw and not everything

mutations.name: C5 the guard is moved BELOW the zero check, intact, which is the real ordering regression: -Infinity is <= 0, so it stops being refused and is folded into a silent empty page
mutations.expectRed: 1.4 a NEGATIVE infinite limit REFUSES, it is not quietly folded into the empty page

mutations.name: C6 the guard weakens from a whole countable number back to merely finite, which readmits the quietest case: a limit in (0,1) truncates to slice(0) and returns the entire retained history
mutations.expectRed: 1.5 a fractional limit 0.5 REFUSES: a count of messages is a whole number
